WITH max_dt AS (
  SELECT MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_purchase_ts
  FROM orders o
)
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  ABS(SUM(p.payment_value)) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
JOIN max_dt m ON TRUE
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= (DATE_TRUNC('month', m.max_purchase_ts) - INTERVAL '11 months')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < (DATE_TRUNC('month', m.max_purchase_ts) + INTERVAL '1 month')
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) ASC;
